rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for fame or wide recognition.

example.english: This cha chaan teng has quite a bit of renown among the locals.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳喺街坊入面幾有名氣。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hai2 gaai1 fong1 jap6 min6 gei2 jau5 ming4 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a more elevated or public sense of renown, especially in writing.

example.english: The scholar enjoys renown in academic circles for rigorous research.
example.traditional: 該學者以嚴謹治學嘅聲名，廣受學界敬重。
example.jyutping: goi1 hok6 ze2 ji5 jim4 gan2 zi6 hok6 ge3 sing1 ming4 gwong2 sau6 hok6 gaai3 ging3 zung6

rows.note: Use this when the renown emphasizes an established person’s prestige or standing rather than celebrity alone.

example.english: That veteran Chinese doctor has considerable renown in the local community.
example.traditional: 嗰位老中醫喺本區行醫幾十年，名望好高。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 lou5 zung1 ji1 hai2 bun2 keoi1 hang4 ji1 gei2 sap6 nin4 ming4 mong6 hou2 gou1
